criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Five frames strong (01, 02, 03, 05, 07); four lean on defaults: 04 empty top wall, rows cropped, screen moire, camera above rows; 08 primitive bus, no privacy cue; 06 binders in a void, slot mid-shelf; 09 headline crosses beams, frieze plate, binder pale yellow.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds; hundred motif changes state in order; amber arrives at 04. Leaks: 08 chrome yellow bus near amber, 07 green and crimson tabs off palette, 09 binder pale yellow.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; nearly 85% kept; per Texas 2036 framing; 04 and 06 counts not verifiable on frame because cropped.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Learns what was reported and no state guidance; close names the district; no deadline or named body.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 29% stated three times blunts the turn; 08 could move.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; drawn to illustrate recurs in six deks; 08 headline flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Unit per hundred is a familiar move; ledgers not read.

one_sentence_fix: Re-shoot slide 04 so all 100 desks and 29 folders sit in frame, the rows filling the empty top, screens without moire.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Empty purple wall over the top 45 percent; desks cut off so 29 and 100 can't be counted; screen moire; camera above rows; no late sun.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back so the whole 10x10 grid sits in frame from y about 500 to 1300, warm sun through the doors, smooth emissive screens.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive yellow box bus, flat pink windows, floating STOP sign, no parents, no privacy tie, yellow competes with amber.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Parents at the covered walk at 1.4 m eye, bus pushed back and muted.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: About 15 binders in a flat blue gradient, slot mid-shelf, 42 promised but not visible.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Build the library wall, empty slot nearest and sharpest with the pill on its edge, the 42 receding.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Headline crosses beams, cone cuts district, dek on a frieze plate, binder pale yellow.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tilt down so beams leave the type zone, seat the dek on a type wash, binder in #ff9f1c.
